description: Visit the Al Fahidi Historical Neighbourhood to see verify traditional wind towers and visit the Coffee Museum. Take an Abra ride across the Creek for 1 AED.
Dine at Pierchic for seafood with views of the Burj Al Arab. For authentic street food, try Al Mallah on 2nd of December Street for shawarma.
Join a sunrise yoga session at Kite Beach. Later, visit the Green Planet biodome to relax among tropical plants.
Skip the main lines and head to Fuunji in Shinjuku for the best tsukemen (dipping noodles).
The Nezu Shrine is a hidden gem with a tunnel of red torii gates similar to Kyoto but much quieter.
